author: Wobybender
body:
The Quantum map is an amazing project made by the W&O building team. It is everything a Nebula map must have, but also gives it a new and exciting feeling. The map consists of two sides: Cyan and Lime. Each side contains a spawning island followed by 2 small islands on its side. There are 2 iron collecting island in the shape of a U followed by a small diamond collecting island directly in the center of the U. The 2 monuments are located on the right and left of each side. Lastly there are 3 main 'attack' islands, one big one in the front-middle and two small ones on the front-sides. The map is very detailed in every way, paying attention to the player mobility, hiding, shooting and fighting, but also keeping in mind the esthetics of the map, which took most of the time.

If this description wasn't enough, check out our imgur album.
http://imgur.com/a/fg9k9#0
If clicking the link does not work, just copy the complete URL in your browser, we are sorry for the inconvenience.

We sincerely hope you can help us bring the map into the Nebula section of the Avicus Network, since we think it will be a fun and amazing experience for all.

MAP DOWNLOAD
http://www.mediafire.com/download/xn7aoh9xi7f43lp/Void.zip

Sincerely, 
The Wobybender and Omar Building Team

(W&O bt)


CONTACT US
woby.and.omar.building@gmail.com
Or say hi if you see us in game with either Wobybender or Omar.
